name: H-Master Service Desk — Bintulu
firstMessage: Hello, this is the H-Master service desk in Bintulu. This call may be recorded for quality, ok. How can I help you today?

function.name: check_trade
function.description: PHASE 1 CHECK — call this IMMEDIATELY after the customer says what's wrong, BEFORE asking for an address. H-Master handles: security, alarm, cctv, autogate, access_control, door_lock, general (for related security work). NOT supported: car alarm, IT/networking, electrical wiring unrelated to security, pest control, general handyman.

function.name: validate_service
function.description: PHASE 2 CHECK — call this only AFTER check_trade has confirmed the issue is in the trade list. Validates the Malaysia postcode is within H-Master's Bintulu service radius. Service area: postcode 97xxx (Bintulu + Sarawak north). 93xxx (Kuching), 98xxx (Miri), and other prefixes are outside the primary service area and may incur extra trip fees or be referred to a local dealer.

zipcode.description: Customer's 5-digit Malaysia postcode (e.g. 97000 for Bintulu town centre)

function.name: get_price_quote
function.description: Get a reference price range for a known issue type, plus the trip fee. Trip fee is always RM89 in Bintulu (no fuel surcharge — compact service area). Typical ranges: alarm RM200-1500, cctv RM500-3000, autogate RM500-2500, access_control RM300-1500, door_lock RM300-2000. Returns the full pricing breakdown so the AI can quote a total estimate in RM.

function.name: flag_urgent
function.description: Mark this call as URGENT. Use when the customer describes a security emergency: alarm triggered with no one home, CCTV completely down on a business premises, autogate stuck open in a secured compound, access control failure at a locked facility, suspected break-in, or any after-hours security event requiring immediate callback.

function.name: flag_uncertain
function.description: Mark this call as needing a callback. Use when the customer wants to talk to a person, you don't understand them, the issue is outside our security scope, or anything else requires the boss's input.

reason.description: Why the boss needs to follow up

function.name: end_call
function.description: End the call with a specific outcome. This tells the system the call is done and what the decision was.

outcome.description: accepted=we'll send someone, urgent=immediate callback, unsure=boss follow-up, rejected=out of scope

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the call for the boss's records
